fields.notes: Security requirements at the simplified spec level are limited to data-integrity (CRC) and access control (Lock/Unlock, WP). All cryptographic content protection (CPRM, Extended Security) is in Part 3 SD Security Specification, which is out of scope of this document but referenced via SCR.SD_SECURITY and SCR.EX_SECURITY fields.
fields.security_summary: Base Physical Layer provides data-integrity (CRC7 + CRC16) but not confidentiality / authentication. Content protection and access control are layered above via Card Lock/Unlock (CMD42, optional COP), CPRM (Part 3 SD Security), and Extended Security.

security_features.name: CRC16 (DAT)
security_features.description: x^16+x^12+x^5+1 (CCITT); per block per active line; not cryptographic.

security_features.name: Card Lock / Unlock (CMD42)
security_features.description: Password up to 16 bytes; locked card only accepts CMD42/CMD13/CMD16 + basic class-0 commands.

security_features.name: Card Ownership Protection (COP)
security_features.description: Added v6.00; stronger lock variant with FEP.

fields.no_base_layer_confidentiality: Base Physical Layer does NOT encrypt user data on the bus. Application-layer encryption is the recommended path for sensitive data.
fields.comparison_to_sibling_emmc: eMMC adds RPMB (Replay-Protected Memory Block) with HMAC-SHA256 + write counter, plus Secure Erase and Secure Trim. SD has no direct RPMB equivalent at the simplified spec level.

extraction_hints: Look for key-management, side-channel, secure-boot sections.
